decision_note: Owner decision 2026-10-23: use for owner-local evaluation only. Weights: MIT (card front matter and text, read at the pinned revision). The card states that models without '-c' in the name were also trained on data with non-commercial licenses (ANLI, WANLI, LingNLI) and that legal opinions diverge on whether this affects the model license. Any use beyond local evaluation must switch to a '-c' variant.

Owner decision 2026-10-23: use for non-commercial owner-local evaluation only. Weights: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial, share-alike for adaptations). Training data: Financial PhraseBank under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; further pre-training on a Reuters TRC2 subset under NIST access terms. Prosus grants no rights in third-party training data. Must not be served in the product, in SaaS, or in any commercial use.
